name: Modern Minimalist TV Bench with Drawers
description: Upgrade your entertainment hub with this sleek, modern TV console! It features a beautiful contrast between its rich walnut/brown wood frame and three clean, minimalist white drawer fronts. It keeps your living room look flawlessly organized by tucking away gaming consoles, controllers, and remotes, while the built-in cable management routes messy wires completely out of sight. Structurally rock-solid and in fantastic shape—ready to add instant modern style to your space!
contact_note: Please bring a truck or a spacious SUV for pickup. Happy to assist with loading it into your vehicle!
meta_description: Pre-owned modern TV Bench in good condition. White drawers with a dark brown wood frame. Built-in cable management, local delivery and pickup options.
name_zh: 现代拼色电视柜带抽屉
description_zh: 非常经典的北欧风现代电视柜！深色木纹框架搭配三组极简纯白无把手抽屉，拼色外观颜值极高。后面自带走线孔，隐藏凌乱线缆，收纳空间巨大。整体框架非常结实，成色良好，轻微使用痕迹，放在卧室或者客厅都非常有高级感。
